description: The catalogue of the facts: key, entity (parcel or unit), group, type, unit, label, description and src (a key of the sources table of the answer) of each field. groups gives the number of fields of each group. Give a group for a short answer; the full catalogue (about 750 fields) comes in parts: next_cursor gives the next part.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous part, with the same other arguments

group.description: only the fields of this group, e.g. climate, valuation, unit

name: list_fields
title: List fields
